content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I've recently purchased a [company_name] [product_name] for student PLC training. While trying to install [product_name] [version_no], the installer asks for a password. Can anyone help me with this issue? Best regards, [user_name]

During installation of [product_name], there should be no password requirement. Only upgrade versions of [product_name] are available for download. These can only be installed if a full version is already present.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faced a password prompt when installing [product_name] and is unsure how to proceed for training purposes. Another user clarified that password prompts generally only appear when installing upgrade versions, not the full product, and that this might be confusing for new users.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to install [product_name] [version_no] without encountering any password barriers and begin using it for training immediately.
